findings.title: DOM/Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Unsanitized Rich Text
findings.description: renderFormattedContent decodes and parses HTML without DOM sanitization before being rendered in dangerouslySetInnerHTML across candidate and admin pages.
findings.remediation: Integrate DOMPurify to strip malicious scripts, handlers (onerror/onload), and unsafe protocols.

findings.title: Exposure of Third-Party API Key in Client Environment
findings.description: VITE_RAPIDAPI_KEY is bundled into client JS files, exposing RapidAPI credentials to all frontend users.
findings.remediation: Remove secret keys from VITE_ frontend env and proxy third-party operations via backend.

findings.title: Missing Security Headers and Uncaught URIError in Node Server
findings.description: Server lacks anti-clickjacking and nosniff headers, and decodeURI throws uncaught exception on malformed URL encoding.
findings.remediation: Add security response headers and wrap decodeURI in safe try-catch handling.
